text: 🇲🇽🔍 “Reducing violence takes permanent work — finding and detaining those who generate it.” "Reducing violence requires permanent work: identifying and detaining the main generators of violence." — President Claudia Sheinbaum She traveled to Zacatecas after the Aug 30 Ojocaliente car bomb; the cabinet reported three detainees and homicides down 85% since September 2024.

🇲🇽✊ The Mexican state is now the country’s second-largest milk buyer. "We are the second most important company in the purchase and distribution of milk in Mexico." — Columba López, Agriculture Secretary Leche para el Bienestar reaches 7 million people, buying from national producers at fair prices. National milk output: 14.4 billion liters.

🇲🇽✊ Wellbeing programs for the countryside reach 2 of every 3 rural people. "The Wellbeing Programs for the countryside benefit 2 out of every 3 people." — Columba López, Agriculture Secretary 13 million producers across 2,470 municipalities, a 107-billion-peso budget: fertilizer, direct support and guaranteed prices for small and mid-size farmers.

🇲🇽🌽 Mexico’s biggest corn harvest on record: 25.41 million tons. "This year we achieved a production of 25.41 million tons of corn." — Columba López, Agriculture Secretary Bean output rose by a record 300,000 tons and Mexico reached bean self-sufficiency; milk hit 14.4 billion liters. Part of Plan México’s food-sovereignty strategy.

🇲🇽✊ “The strategy isn’t aimed at one cartel — it’s aimed at pacifying the country.” "It isn’t directed at one group or one cartel; the security strategy is directed at the pacification of the country." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary Said in response to the Aug 30 Ojocaliente car bomb: about 200 kg of explosives, 11 people injured, three detained.

text: 🇲🇽🔍 Zacatecas: intentional homicides down 85% in under two years. "An 85% drop in the daily average of intentional homicides — from 1.13 a day in September 2024 to 0.17 this August." — Marcela Figueroa, National Public Security System Over five years the daily average fell 96% (4.5 in 2021 → 0.2 in 2026). High-impact crime down 59%, vehicle theft down 42%.

🚨🇲🇽 80% of the guns seized in Mexico come from the United States. "32,000 firearms seized — 80% of them come from the United States." — Omar García Harfuch, Security Secretary The weapons fueling cartel violence are trafficked south from US gun shops. Reported in Zacatecas after the Aug 30 Ojocaliente car-bomb attack.
banner: "80% OF GUNS ARE FROM THE US"

text:
🇲🇽📈 <u>MEXICAN CONSUMER CONFIDENCE HITS A ONE-YEAR HIGH</u>

Consumer confidence rose for a third straight month in August to 46.1 points, breaking a 19-month run of annual declines and reaching its highest level in a year, per INEGI and Banxico data reported by El Economista. Every component climbed — the biggest jump came in how households rate their own current finances, up 1.9 points, as optimism returns to Mexican homes.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>NOW MEXICO WANTS GARCÍA LUNA'S WIFE TOO</u>

President Sheinbaum confirmed Mexico has asked Washington to detain and extradite Linda Cristina Pereyra, wife of jailed ex-security czar Genaro García Luna, on money-laundering and organized-crime charges. The FGR says she was part of a 50-person network that rigged federal prison contracts, costing the treasury over 5.1 billion pesos. This time it's Mexico handing the US the extradition order.
banner: MEXICO SEEKS GARCÍA LUNA WIFE, US

text:
🇲🇽🗳️ <u>MORENA SLAMS THE DOOR ON PARTY-JUMPERS</u>

Ahead of the 2027 elections, Morena created a commission to vet every politician defecting from other parties before they can register. "These types of characters must be evaluated by us," said national leader Ariadna Montiel, after state leaders flagged ex-PRI and ex-PAN mayors trying to climb aboard — a party that has grown from 2.3 to 11.6 million members and polls at 52% for next year's deputy races.
